proposal.summary: A vulnerability was found in SerenityOS affecting the function initialize_typed_array_from_array_buffer in the library Userland/Libraries/LibJS/Runtime/TypedArray.cpp, leading to integer overflow.
proposal.cwe_quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.

C.quote: It has been rated as critical.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Apply the patch f6c6047e49f1517778f5565681fb64750b14bf60 to fix this issue.

evidence_quotes.quote: The manipulation leads to integer overflow.
It has been rated as critical.
no version details of affected nor updated releases are available.
